ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  CG-VAK Software and Exports Limited has significantly expanded its board by appointing three new Non-Executive Independent Directors and proposing a fourth, effective in August and September 2026. These additions introduce diverse expertise in business transformation, ESG, AI, logistics, retail, and banking, aiming to enhance corporate governance and strategic oversight. The substantial influx of independent directors marks a material shift in the company's board composition, aligning with regulatory compliance for strengthening board independence.
